original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区战火重燃，民众担忧全面战争回归
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区的地方武装与国防军爆发冲突，当地居民担忧重返全面战争。冲突已蔓延至邻近的阿法尔和阿姆哈拉地区，并出现恐慌性抢购及互联网和通话服务中断。双方就谁先挑起本轮冲突各执一词，提格雷人民解放阵线称其回应联邦政府进攻，政府则称提格雷武装先发动攻击。

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区地方武装与国防军爆发战斗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Fighting has erupted in Ethiopia's northern region of Tigray between regional forces and the national army.

key_facts.fact: 冲突已蔓延至邻近的阿法尔和阿姆哈拉地区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: This week, major clashes erupted in Tigray and quickly spread into the neighbouring Afar and Amhara regions.

key_facts.fact: 当地出现恐慌性抢购，互联网和通话服务中断
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: There are reports of panic buying - and now internet and call services have been disrupted.

key_facts.fact: 双方就谁先挑起本轮冲突各执一词
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The two sides disagree over who started the latest escalation. The TPLF says it was responding to a federal offensive, including drone strikes, while the government says Tigrayan forces attacked first after seizing control of airports in Tigray.

key_facts.fact: 提格雷武装本周在提格雷首府默克莱街头巡逻
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Tigrayan forces have been patrolling the streets of Tigray's capital, Mekelle, this week
